review: Independent whole-object semantic review of frozen N04 B02-B04 v2 proposals

finding.issue: The prompt specifies the Accepted success postcondition but no failure outcome. The keyed option requires full storage before Accepted, yet the unchecked exception option can also satisfy that contract. The feedback incorrectly supplies an unstated retryable failure result.
finding.minimumCorrection: State the required failure result/recovery contract in the prompt and keep the key aligned, or revise the exception distractor and its feedback so it is wrong under the visible facts. Preserve the ID if the primary decision remains the same.

crossUnitNote.disposition: Not blocking: same-ID/no-duplicate-effect action repeats, but N04-i035 frames it as a RefundProcessor subtype postcondition and adds the refund amount bound.

optionalPrecisionNote.note: The possible inconsistent-read consequence assumes concurrent mutation not stated in the prompt; the raw-representation/need-for-an-aggregate-query rationale independently supports the key.

scopeLimitations: This verdict does not accept the other six N04 units or the complete 162-question cohort.
This is not producer, app-consumer, native, runtime-pool, admission, or full BIZQ-01 acceptance.
